message: Journal and Dreams are now their own screens under Health, each with an optional reminder task, simple formatting (bold, italics, headings, lists and quotes) and a Share button that exports them as a spreadsheet. The journal reminder can come once a day or in each part of the day you pick. Dreams you already wrote on mood entries have moved to Dreams, and a day's journal entries and dreams show on its mood day page and in Looking back. The mood sheet now starts with your mood, and its note is a short line you can add at the bottom.
